label: Maxilla (Upper Jaw)
note: Open arc — outer perimeter only. No bottom edge; that is closed at render time by the cervical scallop in bonePath(). Two sub-paths: sub-path 1 = M(top) → R-side → R-cervical; sub-path 2 = M(L-cervical) → L-side → top. bonePath() finds the mid-M by scanning for the second M, bridges via L commands into/out of scallopRL(). Mirror workflow: mirror each sub-path independently; keep the mid-M endpoint at cervical-level y on both sides.
